files.name: Voice test C2 — ACTED (Fenrir / Jessica)
files.note: Same two voices as test C, but directed: per-beat rate, pitch lift with formant preservation, stressed words +2-4 dB, two real inhales, exact pauses. Cat pitch range +41%, mouse +29% brighter.

files.name: Voice test C — Fenrir / Jessica
files.note: Cat am_fenrir 133 Hz, mouse af_jessica 205 Hz — two high-energy voices, Jessica is the fastest talker in the pool. Fenrir is hot and needed peak-capping.

files.name: Voice test B — George / Isabella
files.note: Cat bm_george 145 Hz — warm British storyteller. Mouse bf_isabella 202 Hz. Softest and most nursery-friendly; narrower 57 Hz gap.

files.name: Voice test A — Puck / Bella
files.note: Cat am_puck 110 Hz — bright, energetic, cheekiest of the three. Mouse af_bella 197 Hz. Widest pitch gap at 87 Hz, easiest for a 3-6 year old to follow who is talking.

files.name: Pip and the Snail — v4 (HyperFrames + Rhubarb)
files.note: Five shots, three hard cuts, close-up on the face. Articulated 8-part fox rig with knee joints, lids, brows and a hinged jaw driven by Rhubarb. Snail voiced separately.
